summary: A 300 mm fab of United Nova Technology (named 绍兴中芯集成 until 2023) in the Shaoxing Binhai New Area, run by a majority-owned subsidiary. A CNY 4.2 billion pilot line of 10,000 wafers a month, approved in January 2023, had its tools installed and its process line connected in 2023, and by early 2024 its IGBT, superjunction, HVIC and BCD platforms were in volume production. A May 2023 siting agreement with the Binhai New Area extended it into a CNY 22.2 billion, 100,000-wafer-a-month mixed-signal project, and in January 2024 the company set its volume-production stage at CNY 18 billion and 90,000 wafers a month, with production due to start in 2025. In October 2025 the company said initial construction was complete and all process platforms were in volume production; civil works were still in progress in mid-2026.

location.note: The filings place the project in Shaoxing and its expansion in the Binhai New Area under the siting agreement. The project company's registered address is 518-17 Linjiang Road, Gaobu Subdistrict, Yuecheng District; no address is given for the fab itself.

Process line connected in 2023; the parent's proceeds report gives 30 September 2023 as the date the pilot line reached its intended usable state, and by March 2024 the company said its IGBT, superjunction, HVIC and BCD platforms had entered volume production.
The overall project was planned to begin production in 2025; sources read here do not separate output from this stage.

notes: The parent's 2026 interim report shows the volume-production stage, partly funded from IPO proceeds, scheduled to reach its intended usable condition by 31 December 2027, with about 90% of those proceeds spent, and civil works of the project company in progress at about CNY 450 million on 30 June 2026. In 2025 a policy-finance arm of China Development Bank provided the parent CNY 1.8 billion for five years, which it injected into the project company as capital. The project company had revenue of about CNY 1.33 billion and a net loss of about CNY 1.19 billion in 2025, and revenue of about CNY 838 million and a net loss of about CNY 150 million in the first half of 2026. The company's 2025 annual report says the 300 mm silicon line will focus on BCD, MCU and other high-end mixed-signal and control products. The Phase 4 line run by a separate joint venture is the existing record china-unt-shaoxing-phase-4; in 2026 the parent and its subsidiaries agreed to transfer and license related patents and know-how to that venture for about CNY 1.21 billion. Process nodes are not stated for this line; the 2023 annual report mentions company-wide BCD research at 90nm and 55nm.

Audit fixes (2026-11-07): Reworded the summary so the CNY 18 billion, 90,000-wafer volume-production stage is dated to the January 2024 announcement rather than the May 2023 siting agreement; ownership, financing, capacity, proceeds dates and the project company's results were re-checked and matched.
